name: AUSOM
summary: Apple Users' Society of Melbourne, volunteer Mac user group (not a commercial ISP); ran a BBS from ~1994, then its own 'AUSOM Internet' dialup/hosting/FirstClass; handed its 542 ISP users to Labyrinth Connections Oct 1999 (confirmed from email archive); now purely a user group.

events.details: AUSOM BBS became full-time internet ~1994 (est. as a user group 1982).
Handed its 542 ISP users to Labyrinth Connections (Oct 1999).
